🎴 Pathfinder Character Cards

"The fighter laminated Sudden Charge. The GM laminated the hazard."

Print a Pathfinder character's Strikes, feats, class features, and spells as cut-out cards, with any item beside them, so the rules sit on the table instead of in a book.

✨ Items

    On the cards

      🎴 Cards

      Poker-size cards (2.5 × 3.5 in, 63 × 88 mm), nine to a page with dashed lines to cut along. Print at 100% scale (not "fit to page"). Tick Backs too and print on both sides (flip on the long edge) for a patterned back on every card. A feat, spell, or item too long for one card carries on to the next.

      Characters come from the Character Builder and stay in this browser; this page only reads them. The items you pick live in the address bar, so 🔗 Copy Link shares them.
      Feat, feature, ancestry, background, spell, and item text is from Pathfinder Player Core, Player Core 2, and GM Core (Paizo Inc.), used under the ORC License. Weapon trait lines and the vision senses are short summaries in the Gazette's own words.

      Pathfinder cards at the table

      A Pathfinder character collects feats fast, and by level 5 nobody remembers what half of them do. Cards pull out the parts you use: each Strike with its three attack bonuses and damage worked out, each feat with its actions and full text, and each spell with its cast, range, and defense. Lay them out in front of you, turn a card sideways once a once-a-day feat is spent, and hand an item's card to whoever carries it.

      What's on each card

      • ⚔️ Strikes: one per weapon on the character, plus a fist. To hit is shown at each step of the multiple attack penalty (agile weapons use −4 and −8), and damage counts Strength, striking runes, and weapon specialization. The card says what each weapon trait does.
      • 📘 Class features: what your class gives you up to your level, with your class choice (school, bloodline, instinct, and the rest). Plain proficiency steps like Reflex Expertise stay on the sheet.
      • ⭐ Feats: every feat you picked, plus the ones your background and class give you, with its action cost in the corner.
      • 🧬 Ancestry features and your heritage, and your 🎒 background.
      • 🔮 Spells: your cantrips, repertoire or prepared spells (a spellbook's whole contents if nothing is prepared yet), granted spells, and focus spells, colored by tradition with the rank in the corner.
      • ✨ Items: any Pathfinder item with rules text, colored by rarity, with its level in the corner.

      Printing

      Pick Letter or A4, print at 100%, and cut along the dashed lines. The cards are the size of a standard playing card, so they fit card sleeves.

      Works with

      Build the character in the Character Builder and pick spells in the Spell Planner; the cards follow both. Keep your notes in the Player Journal and roll a past in the Backstory Generator.
